title: Las cuerdas: las habilidades de cada combate
description: docs/quests/marta.md § The qualities, § Final boss. Every named move of Las cuerdas' foes and La Voz, frozen as it lands (fight tester: Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost). Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.hitFoe = id => { cmd('attack'); setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-target="' + id + '"]')?.click(), 500); }; const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.shot-frozen * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }'; document.head.append(st); window.sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.round = async (id, what = 'attack') => { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { while (!ready()) await sleep(100); cmd(what); await sleep(450); document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-target="' + id + '"]')?.click(); await sleep(500); } }; window.frozen = ''; window.catchPop = (text, after = 140) => { window.frozen = ''; const o = new MutationObserver(() => { if ([...document.querySelectorAll('.damage-pop')].some(p => p.textContent.includes(text))) { o.disconnect(); setTimeout(() => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = text; }, after); } }); o.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); }; window.thaw = () => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 1; document.documentElement.classList.remove('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = ''; };

steps.caption: Juramento: the shield out at arm's length, its strings sounding, the blow straight at whoever touched her last
Resonancia: the Eco's rings open and roll onto the same one
Picker moment «Lazo: el Eco caído»: the chip says «Lazo → Eco»
Lazo: the amber cord from her knot, rings closing where the Eco comes back
The Eco back, whole, its Resonancia from the start

steps.caption: Destello: the string inside the glass, sent back in one thin beam
Estallido: one blow more and it cracks, and what comes off reaches everyone
Cracked: it leans, its shards fly wide, the chip says «Rajado» and «Prisma → todos»
Prisma: its light split into the four notes' colours, onto everyone

steps.caption: Golpe directo: the shortest way between two points
En línea recta: one stroke through everyone
Picker moment «Estocada»: the lance drawn from further back
Estocada: everything it has, in one thick stroke
Clavado: the lance stays in the floor until its next turn, and it takes more

steps.caption: Guardia: a lattice of strings in front of her
Coro (Allegro): a ring leaves her throat and her second voice comes together beside her
The second voice, standing: an Eco of her own
«Toma aire» (A capela): the four notes' light drawn into her throat
Holding it: arms up, her rings wide, the chip says «Calderón → todos»
Calderón: the held note let go, four great rings over everyone (both holding on)
